experiment: Three-way content mode parent-parent similarity comparison
description: Compare parent-only pairwise similarity distributions across content modes
key_findings: Text-only (user+assistant) has highest baseline similarity (μ=0.847) — AI voice homogenizes embedding space
User-only has lowest mean (μ=0.612) — user prompts maximally differentiate sessions
Assistant-only has intermediate mean (μ=0.673) but lowest max (0.9727) and tightest spread (σ=0.064)
Assistant-only network is essentially empty for parents: max 1 edge above θ=0.90
User prompts carry topical fingerprint; AI responses add consistent semantic scaffolding
Combined text works best because AI scaffolding normalizes space while user specificity creates high-similarity peaks
